name: Image Sets Detection & Controls
changes: Improves numbered Image Set identification using filename leading sequences and series labels.
Uses explicitly numbered post subjects to identify albums when image filenames are generic.
Makes Image Sets ON/OFF clear in the Newsgroups toolbar and Settings while reusing the existing persisted setting.
Switching OFF immediately restores the individual-image gallery/list and resets grouped-index state.
regression_guards: Three-member threshold, newsgroup/media-kind/poster isolation, and year guards remain.
v3.7.5 grouped Continuous-browsing article-key stabilization remains.
v3.7.7 splitter behavior and CSS are unchanged.
SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, managed updates and runtime processing remain unchanged.
preserved: NNTP throughput/connection tuning, thumbnails, viewer, gallery virtualization, Direct Unpack and PAR2/repair.
Automation, Smart Import, Backup & Restore and all twelve themes.
Metadata Server 0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector 1.0.31 remain unchanged.
